uncertain.note: marker keyed a2: the alphabet restarts at 'a' with ANNOT. XXXIII (§4). The line-end sign after 'arri' is the same rounded blob as at 'iour-', read as a hyphen.
the print sets 'ex.' then a small gap then the line-end hyphen; spacing normalized per §1.
'prelato' is printed with a plain e, not the æ ligature (prælato); sic.
a hyphen, not a period, is printed between 'quinto' and 'D.' (same dash shape as the line-end hyphens in this italic font), with a visible gap before the D; transcribed as printed, sic.
note b is printed beside the TEXTE heading, not beside a body line, so beside_line is null.
note a2 starts in the gap between 'nee de S. Laurens.' and the ANNOT. XXXIII heading, ahead of its marker line, so beside_line is null. Its key letter is a heavily inked italic a.
'rutela' for 'tutela': the first glyph is a short italic r with a shoulder, not the tall crossed t that follows it in the same word; transcribed as printed, sic.
